main.remarks: Manifests are registered by tool schema identifier and may also be bound to tool types.

field.name: Sync
field.summary: Synchronization gate for manifest registration updates.

method.name: GetLocked
method.summary: Get the current registry locked state.
method.returns: True if manifest registration writes are locked; otherwise false.

method.name: Lock
method.param: Optional management key used to create an unlock code. Null creates a permanent lock that cannot be unlocked.
method.returns: True if the registry was locked successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryBindType
method.summary: Bind a tool type to an already registered tool schema identifier.
method.returns: True if the tool type was bound successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryBindManifest
method.summary: Bind a tool type to a manifest using the manifest schema identifier.
method.param: Manifest whose schema identifier should be bound.
method.returns: True if the tool type was bound successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryGetManifestBySchemaID
method.summary: Try to get a registered manifest by tool schema identifier.
method.returns: True if a manifest was found; otherwise false.

method.name: TryGetBoundSchemaID
method.summary: Try to get the tool schema identifier currently bound to a tool type.
method.returns: True if the tool type is bound; otherwise false.

method.name: TryGetBindings
method.summary: Try to get all tool types currently bound to a tool schema identifier.
method.returns: True if the schema is registered; otherwise false.

method.name: TryGetCurrentManifest
method.summary: Try to get the currently registered manifest for a bound tool type.
method.returns: True if the tool type is bound and the manifest is registered; otherwise false.

method.name: TryGetManifestByType
method.summary: Try to get a registered manifest by tool type binding.
method.returns: True if a manifest was found; otherwise false.

method.name: TryRegisterManifest
method.summary: Register a manifest by its schema identifier.
method.returns: True if the manifest was valid and registered successfully. Returns false when the tool schema identifier is already registered; unregister first to replace it.

method.name: TryRegisterAndBindManifest
method.summary: Register a manifest and bind a tool type to that manifest schema identifier.
method.returns: True if the manifest was registered and the tool type was bound successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryResolveOperationBySchemaID
method.summary: Try to resolve a manifest-scoped operation index by tool schema identifier and method name.
method.returns: True if the operation was resolved; otherwise false.

method.name: TryResolveOperationByType
method.summary: Try to resolve a manifest-scoped operation index by tool type binding and method name.
method.returns: True if the operation was resolved; otherwise false.

method.name: TryUnRegisterSchemaID
method.summary: Try to unregister a manifest by schema identifier.
method.returns: True if the manifest was unregistered; otherwise false.

method.name: TryUnBindType
method.summary: Try to remove a tool type binding from the registry.
method.returns: True if the tool type binding was removed; otherwise false.

method.name: UnLock
method.summary: Unlock manifest registration writes using the management key that created the unlock code.
method.param: Management key used to unlock the registry.
method.returns: True if the registry was unlocked successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryCreateEntry
method.summary: Try to validate a manifest and create its immutable registry entry.
method.returns: True if the manifest was valid and the entry was created; otherwise false.

method.name: CreateUnlockCode
method.summary: Create a secure unlock code from management-key material.
method.param: Management key used to derive the unlock code.

main.summary: Immutable registry entry containing a manifest and its precomputed method index map.

property.name: MethodIndexes
property.summary: Precomputed method name to operation index map.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.param: Precomputed method name to operation index map.

property.name: BySchemaID
property.summary: Registered manifests keyed by tool schema identifier.

property.name: Locked
property.summary: True when manifest registration writes are locked.

property.name: SchemaIDByType
property.summary: Optional tool type bindings keyed to tool schema identifiers.

property.name: UnlockCode
property.summary: Secure unlock code. Null while unlocked or permanently locked.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.param: Registered manifests keyed by tool schema identifier.
Optional tool type bindings keyed to tool schema identifiers.
True when manifest registration writes are locked.
